faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about LeaseIO.

document_count.a: Each master lease counts as one document. Each amendment to a lease also counts as one document. So a master lease with two amendments would use 3 of your document limit.

ai_extraction.q: How does the AI extraction work?
ai_extraction.a: Our AI reads your PDF lease document and extracts key information like parties, dates, rent amounts, escalation schedules, and important clauses. You then review and confirm the extracted data before finalizing.

edit_data.q: Can I edit the extracted data?
edit_data.a: Absolutely. After AI extraction, you review everything in a side-by-side view with the original PDF. You can edit any field before finalizing the lease abstract.

document_limit.q: What happens if I hit my document limit?
document_limit.a: You won't be able to upload new documents until you upgrade your plan or your billing period resets. Existing documents remain fully accessible.

data_ownership.a: You do. Your documents and extracted data belong to you. You can export everything at any time, and if you close your account, we delete your data within 30 days.

security.a: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit. Our infrastructure is SOC 2 compliant, and we support role-based access controls within your workspace.

multiple_users.q: Can I have multiple users in my workspace?
multiple_users.a: Yes. You can invite team members with different roles: Owner, Admin, Manager, Reviewer, or Read-only. Each role has specific permissions for billing, integrations, and lease management.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.paragraph1: We collect information you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, company name, timezone, and password (stored only as a salted hash) when you register for an account.
section1.paragraph2: We collect the lease documents you upload to LeaseIO and the structured data we extract from them. We do not use analytics, tracking pixels, session-replay tools, or non-essential cookies.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.intro: We use the information we collect to:
section2.bullet1: Provide, maintain, and improve the LeaseIO service
section2.bullet2: Process your lease documents using AI to extract structured terms
section2.bullet3: Send transactional notifications about your leases, approvals, and account
section2.bullet4: Process subscription payments and send invoices
section2.bullet5: Respond to your comments, questions, and support requests

section3.title: 3. Sub-processors
section3.intro: We share specific data with the following sub-processors, each under a written Data Processing Agreement. We do not sell your data and do not share it with any party not listed below.
section3.anthropic_purpose: Extract structured terms from lease documents
section3.anthropic_data: Lease document content. Operated under zero data retention; not used to train Anthropic's models.
section3.azure_purpose: Optical character recognition for scanned PDFs
section3.azure_data: Lease document bytes. Content logging is disabled at the API level.
section3.supabase_purpose: Hosts our database, authentication, and file storage
section3.supabase_data: All account data, lease metadata, and uploaded documents.
section3.stripe_data: Email, billing name, and payment method (we never see card numbers).
section3.resend_data: Recipient email and email body. Approval emails are minimized to a CTA and link.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.paragraph1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information and documents. Data is encrypted at rest by our cloud providers and in transit using TLS. Access to production systems is restricted, audited, and protected by row-level security policies that scope every record to the workspace it belongs to.

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.paragraph1: Lease documents and the data extracted from them are retained for the duration of your active subscription. If you cancel or delete your account, we delete your documents and account data within 30 days. Some derivative records (encrypted backups, audit logs required for legal or accounting purposes) may persist for up to 90 additional days before being permanently purged.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.paragraph1: You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal information. You can delete your account at any time from Account Settings, which permanently removes your documents, profile, and authentication record. For data export, correction, or any other Data Subject Access Request, email privacy@theleaseio.com — we respond within 30 days as required by GDPR. EU and UK users may also lodge a complaint with their local supervisory authority.

section7.title: 7. Contact Us
section7.paragraph1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.paragraph1: By accessing or using LeaseIO, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use our service.

section2.title: 2. Description of Service
section2.paragraph1: LeaseIO provides AI-powered lease abstraction and lease operations management services. Our platform extracts key terms from lease documents, tracks important dates, and integrates with accounting systems.

section3.title: 3. User Accounts
section3.paragraph1: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account.

section4.title: 4. Subscription and Billing
section4.paragraph1: Subscriptions are billed monthly in advance. Document limits are enforced per billing period. Each master lease counts as one document, and each amendment counts as one additional document.

section5.title: 5. Data Ownership
section5.paragraph1: You retain all rights to your lease documents and extracted data. We do not claim ownership of any content you upload to our service. You may export your data at any time.

section6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
section6.paragraph1: LeaseIO is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any errors in AI-extracted data. Users are responsible for reviewing and verifying all extracted information before finalizing.

section7.title: 7. Termination
section7.paragraph1: You may cancel your subscription at any time. We may terminate your account for violation of these terms. Upon termination, your data will be deleted within 30 days.
